title: Workforce Planning Brief
management_problem: HR teams struggle to synthesise workforce data, attrition trends, and skills gaps into a leadership-ready brief within short timelines.
how_ai_helps: AI can convert raw workforce observations into a structured brief with key findings, risks, and workforce recommendations.
sample_prompt: Act as an HR strategy analyst. Using the following workforce observations, prepare a leadership brief covering: key trends, critical skill gaps, attrition risks, recommended interventions, and a 30-day action timeline. Use only the provided data.
expected_output: Executive workforce brief with key findings and recommendations
limitation: AI cannot access real HR data or verify figures; human verification is essential.
human_oversight: A qualified HR professional must verify all figures and recommendations before the brief is circulated.
discussion_question: What workforce data would you consider too sensitive to include in an AI-drafted brief, and why?

title: Training Needs Analysis
management_problem: Managers often lack a structured method for translating performance observations into a coherent training needs analysis document.
how_ai_helps: AI can help convert selected performance themes into a structured training needs analysis with learning objectives and recommended interventions.
sample_prompt: Act as a learning and development specialist. Convert the following performance observations into a training needs analysis. Include: priority skill gaps, recommended training interventions, target audience, suggested delivery format, and success measures.
limitation: AI cannot independently verify whether performance data is accurate or representative.
human_oversight: A senior training manager must validate the needs analysis before any programme is designed or budget is committed.
discussion_question: How would you decide which performance observations are safe to include in an AI-assisted training needs analysis?

title: Process Improvement Note
management_problem: Operational teams frequently identify inefficiencies but struggle to document them in a format suitable for management review and approval.
how_ai_helps: AI can help convert raw operational observations into a structured process improvement note with root cause analysis, recommendations, and a pilot plan.
sample_prompt: Act as a process improvement analyst. Using the following observations, create a structured process improvement note with: current-state summary, identified root causes, proposed improvements, risk considerations, and a 60-day pilot plan.
expected_output: Process improvement note with root cause analysis and pilot plan
limitation: AI may miss domain-specific constraints; process experts must review the analysis.
human_oversight: A senior operations manager must review the improvement note before any workflow changes are authorised.
discussion_question: Which aspects of a process improvement proposal are most likely to require domain expertise that AI cannot provide?

title: Budget Review Support
management_problem: Finance review teams need to identify spending anomalies and prepare management notes quickly before budget discussions.
how_ai_helps: AI can help structure anonymised budget data into a review note with observations, anomalies, questions for the finance team, and risk flags.
sample_prompt: Act as a financial governance advisor. Review the following anonymised budget summary. Identify: key observations, unusual spending patterns, budget risks, and three questions for the finance review meeting.
expected_output: Budget review note with observations and review questions
limitation: AI must not handle actual financial data; anonymised or dummy data only. All figures require official verification.
human_oversight: A finance officer must verify all observations and questions before the note is shared with budget holders.
discussion_question: What information would you remove from a budget table before using AI to help structure it for review?

title: Patient Communication Improvement
management_problem: Healthcare management teams need to improve patient-facing communications but lack time to review and rewrite standard templates.
how_ai_helps: AI can help review and rewrite patient communication templates for clarity, tone, and comprehensiveness, using only approved draft text.
sample_prompt: Act as a healthcare communications specialist. Review the following patient communication template. Rewrite it for: clarity, appropriate tone, completeness, accessibility, and a clear call to action. Do not add clinical claims or medical advice.
limitation: AI must not add clinical guidance or medical information. All rewrites require clinical and legal sign-off.
human_oversight: Clinical and legal teams must review any revised patient communication before it is published or distributed.
discussion_question: What types of healthcare communication changes should require clinical review even if the language revision seems minor?

title: Learning Programme Design
management_problem: Educators and programme designers often need to create structured session plans but struggle with time constraints and format consistency.
how_ai_helps: AI can help convert learning objectives and topic outlines into a structured session plan with activities, timing, and assessment ideas.
sample_prompt: Act as an instructional designer. Using the following learning objectives and topic outline, create a 90-minute session plan with: session opening, three core content sections, one learner activity per section, timing allocation, and an assessment question for each section.
expected_output: Structured 90-minute session plan with activities and assessments
limitation: AI cannot assess what will resonate with a specific learner group; facilitator adaptation is essential.
human_oversight: The facilitator must review the session plan against the actual learner group and adjust for context and pacing.
discussion_question: How would you test whether an AI-generated session plan is appropriate for your specific learner group?

title: Supply Chain Risk Summary
management_problem: Supply chain managers frequently need to prepare risk summaries before leadership reviews but struggle with format consistency and comprehensiveness.
how_ai_helps: AI can convert a list of supply chain observations and concerns into a structured risk summary with likelihood ratings, impacts, and mitigation steps.
sample_prompt: Act as a supply chain risk analyst. Convert the following supply chain observations into a risk summary with: risk description, likelihood, operational impact, mitigation recommendation, and escalation trigger for each item.
expected_output: Supply chain risk summary with mitigation recommendations
limitation: AI cannot verify supplier data or market conditions. Risk ratings require domain expert validation.
human_oversight: A supply chain manager with relevant domain knowledge must validate all risk ratings and mitigation recommendations.
discussion_question: Which supply chain risks would you consider too operationally sensitive to process through a public AI tool?

title: Policy Simplification Note
management_problem: Public administrators often need to translate lengthy policy documents into accessible implementation guides for operational managers.
how_ai_helps: AI can help simplify public-domain policy text into a structured implementation note with key obligations, action points, and clarification flags.
sample_prompt: Act as a policy communication specialist. Using the following public policy extract, prepare an implementation note for operational managers. Include: key obligations, required actions, timeline, items needing official clarification, and a compliance checklist.
expected_output: Policy implementation note with compliance checklist
limitation: AI may misinterpret policy nuance; simplified notes must not be used as substitute for official guidance.
human_oversight: A policy expert must review all AI-assisted simplifications before they are distributed to operational managers.
discussion_question: What is the risk of treating an AI-generated policy simplification as a substitute for official legal or compliance advice?

title: Stakeholder Engagement Plan
management_problem: Project managers frequently need to develop stakeholder engagement plans but lack a structured template and sufficient time for comprehensive mapping.
how_ai_helps: AI can help build a stakeholder engagement plan from a list of stakeholder groups, interests, and communication preferences.
sample_prompt: Act as a stakeholder engagement specialist. Using the following stakeholder list and context, create a structured engagement plan with: stakeholder group, key interest, preferred communication channel, frequency, key message, and feedback mechanism.
expected_output: Stakeholder engagement plan with communication schedule
limitation: AI-generated stakeholder maps may miss political sensitivities and informal power dynamics that require human judgement.
human_oversight: A senior manager familiar with the organisational context must review the engagement plan before it is implemented.
discussion_question: What aspects of stakeholder mapping require human relationship intelligence that AI cannot replicate from a list alone?

title: Meeting Documentation
management_problem: Organisations frequently lose institutional knowledge because meeting discussions are not captured systematically or converted into accessible records.
how_ai_helps: AI can convert raw meeting notes into structured minutes with decisions, owners, deadlines, and open items.
sample_prompt: Act as an executive coordinator. Convert the following raw meeting notes into formal minutes. Use: agenda, discussion summary, decisions taken, action items with owners and deadlines, and pending issues. Do not invent decisions or owners not present in the notes.
expected_output: Formal meeting minutes with action items and deadlines
limitation: AI cannot verify whether all discussion points were captured. Missing context will produce incomplete minutes.
human_oversight: The meeting chair must review and approve all AI-assisted minutes before they are circulated as official records.
discussion_question: What types of decisions or commitments made in a meeting should never appear in AI-drafted minutes without explicit human confirmation?

title: Performance Review Preparation
management_problem: Managers preparing performance review documentation often struggle with consistency, tone, and ensuring that feedback is actionable rather than merely descriptive.
how_ai_helps: AI can help structure performance observation notes into a review framework with strengths, development areas, and recommended goals.
sample_prompt: Act as an HR advisory specialist. Using the following performance observations, prepare a structured review framework with: key strengths, development priorities, behavioural examples, recommended goals, and suggested support actions. Maintain a constructive and factual tone.
expected_output: Structured performance review framework with development goals
limitation: AI must not use personal identifying information. All performance notes require direct manager validation before use.
human_oversight: The line manager must review and personalise all AI-drafted performance notes before they are discussed with the individual.
discussion_question: How do you ensure that AI-assisted performance reviews remain fair, accurate, and free from bias?

title: Executive Dashboard Narrative
management_problem: Senior leaders often receive data dashboards but lack a concise accompanying narrative that explains key trends, risks, and priorities.
how_ai_helps: AI can help convert dashboard data points into a structured narrative with insights, anomalies, and recommended leadership attention areas.
sample_prompt: Act as a senior analyst. Using the following dashboard summary, prepare a one-page executive narrative with: key performance highlights, concerning trends, risk areas requiring attention, and three recommended actions for leadership review.
limitation: AI cannot interpret whether a trend represents a genuine concern without domain knowledge. Human analysts must contextualise the data.
human_oversight: A senior analyst must review the narrative against the actual data before it is shared with leadership.
discussion_question: How would you guard against an AI-generated dashboard narrative drawing incorrect conclusions from ambiguous data?
